Class Downloader

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Thread
projetosd.Downloader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class Downloader extends Thread
Downloader for fetching and processing web pages. Handles downloading, parsing, indexing, and queueing new URLs.

    • multicastEntries

      public boolean multicastEntries(String url, ArrayList<String> words, String title, String citation, ArrayList<String> relatedUrls, Map<Integer,BarrelInterface> barrels) throws RemoteException
      Multicasts page entries to all active Barrels. This is a best-effort reliable multicast since sync fixes the rest
      Parameters:
      url - Page url
      words - Words in page
      title - Page title
      citation - Short description/citation from the page
      relatedUrls - Urls found in the page
      barrels - Map of active barrels
      Returns:
      Boolean that if true multicast worked, if false no info was introduced in any Barrel (DB) so downloaders must re-insert url into queue
      Throws:
      RemoteException - RMI Exception
